case_number: 2024 INSC 197; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1511 OF 2024 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (Crl.) No.2874 OF 2023)
summary: Bail denied in murder/arms case; trial at fag end with witnesses largely examined; chargesheet scrutiny; Cr.P.C. s.173(2) compliance mandated; deficient chargesheets lacking details/particulars; DGP directed to review chargesheet standards; investigation procedure requirements under s.157, s.169, s.170, s.172; police report essentials emphasized; trial court ordered to expedite witness examination.
final_judgment: Bail appeal dismissed; chargesheet compliance directives issued; trial court ordered to conclude witness examination within four months.
